content:
elena: Heads-up — onboarding e2e started failing after today's typegen regen. auth-retry tests are throwing different defaults.
rahul: CI job?
elena: job #4309. Failure snippet: ```
FAIL auth/retry.spec.ts
  Expected retryAttempts to be 2 but received 0
  at tests/retry.spec.ts:18:8
```
ben: That looks like the generated client lost its default retry wrapper. Any regendiff?
regen-bot: publish-checker: regen mismatch detected for 'ts-sdk'. Files changed: generated/clients/authClient.ts. Semver impact: potential minor (behavioral).
carla: Did someone change defaults in another SDK? We had a go-sdk backoff tweak last release.
rahul: Confirmed — go-sdk PR #351 changed backoff from exponential to fixed; ts-sdk wasn't updated.
elena: Which part of typegen caused it?
ben: I dug in — the JSON examples block order shifted during regen. The generator collapsed two example blocks and the resulting client factory omitted the retry wrapper due to how defaults are inferred from example presence.
carla: Yikes. So two problems: non-deterministic ordering causing noisy regens and a hidden coupling between examples and runtime defaults.
rahul: Short term: patch sample-app to explicitly pass retryPolicy in examples so CI won't depend on inferred defaults. I'll do a tiny PR.
ben: Long term: add deterministic sorting to the generator and decouple default inference from example ordering. I'll open a codegen PR to enforce stable ordering + a unit test that hashes generated output.
carla: Also we need a changelog entry if we update ts-sdk behavior to match go-sdk — this is a behavioral change and must be a minor semver bump. publishflow will block without a changelog.
elena: OK plan: 1) rahul patches sample-app to be explicit (hotfix), 2) ben adds deterministic sort + regen test, 3) carla drafts changelog and coordinates a ts-sdk minor release to align defaults.
rahul: Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood/sample-apps/pull/412 — sets retryPolicy in examples. Triggering CI.
ben: Codegen PR: https://github.com/redwood/codegen/pull/812 — stable-sort + deterministic example hashing + regen script. Local regen matches expected hash.
regen-bot: CI triggered: regen-and-publish job started for thread 1769990001.
carla: Draft changelog text: "Align TypeScript SDK retry/backoff defaults with Go SDK to restore parity and avoid onboarding regressions." Thoughts?
elena: Fine. Add link to sample-app hotfix and codegen PRs.
ben: CI green on codegen branch. Rerunning publish-checker.
regen-bot: publish-checker: regen-diff resolved. No blocking regendiffs detected.
carla: Preparing ts-sdk v0.14.0 release with the changelog entry. (Minor bump because it's a behavioral alignment.)
rahul: Sample-app tests green after bumping to ts-sdk@0.14.0.
elena: Follow-ups: add a lint in codegen to forbid example-driven default extraction without an explicit feature flag, and add a short devex note explaining semver expectations for behavioral parity changes.
carla: I'll take the devex note. ben, please add the lint in the codegen PR.
ben: Will do. Closing this thread after PR merges. Thanks everyone :party:
